calibration.name: signed_spd
calibration.calibration_outcome: Full Maxwell calibration reached 1e-7 equation tolerance
calibration.scope: Full Maxwell material-only calibration. The source profiles, drive gain, decoder and reference-grid interpolation data remain fixed throughout tuning and verification.

verification.residual_bound_scope: Finite matrix: equation error <= exact-device error + gain * relative Maxwell residual. The product norm bound covers arbitrary field residual directions and every right-hand side; no continuum or asymptotic conditioning claim.

intermediate_refinement.residual_bound_scope: Finite matrix: equation error <= exact-device error + gain * relative Maxwell residual. The product norm bound covers arbitrary field residual directions and every right-hand side; no continuum or asymptotic conditioning claim.

waveguide_calibration.platform: Cutoff PEC waveguide; separable TE10 chain control, not the periodic construction
